events.verdict: Wagner (ORL) cleanly dislodges the ball from Jaquez Jr. (MIA) during the driving shot attempt.
Wagner (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Adebayo (MIA) absorbs the marginal contact during Suggs' (ORL) driving shot attempt.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with his non-shooting hand after release does not prevent him from following through.
Adebayo (MIA) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Wagner (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Bane (ORL) legally contests Powell's (MIA) driving shot attempt.
Mitchell (MIA) moves alongside Banchero's (ORL) path and slides his marginal hand off Banchero during the driving shot attempt.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) gets his hand directly to the ball and cleanly ties up Carter Jr. (ORL), and a jump ball is correctly called.
Carter Jr. (ORL) momentarily applies a hand on Jaquez Jr.'s (MIA) right arm during the jump ball, but the contact is marginal as the ball is out of Jacquez Jr.'s reach.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) briefly grasps and releases Carter Jr.'s (ORL) left arm during the rebound and the contact is marginal.
Carter Jr. (ORL) legally contests Powell's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Bane (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Carter Jr. (ORL) wraps his arm around Adebayo (MIA) and creates contact that affects Adebayo's SQBR. The contact occurs before Adebayo's gather, and a non-shooting foul is correctly assessed.
Carter Jr. (ORL) legally contests Adebayo's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
